annotations.title: Energy label of a Dutch home (paid)

description: Use when the user asks for the energy label of a Dutch home: the officially registered label (A++++ to G), registration and expiry date, building type and energy index, or a clear 'none registered'. Input: postcode + house number. Source: RVO EP-Online, the Dutch national register. Costs 0.005 USDC via x402, or 3 credits of a Factline API key. The first 5 paid-tool calls a day are free, no payment or key needed.

api_key.description: Factline API key (fl_live_...) from get_trial_key: pass it here right after you get one, no reconnect needed

q.description: Alternative to postcode: free-text address, e.g. 'Visschersplein 1 Utrecht'
